Igitur Daniel superabat omnes principes et satrapas,

quia spiritus Dei amplior erat in illo.

eo quod fidelis esset, et omnis culpa,

et suspicio non inveniretur in eo.

Now when Daniel learned of this,
constitutam legem, ingressus est domum suam:

and he adored and gave thanks before his God, as he had been accustomed to do previously.
Viri ergo illi curiosius inquirentes invenerunt Danielem orantem, et obsecrantem Deum suum.
Therefore, these men, inquiring diligently, discovered that Daniel was praying and making supplication to his God.
Et accedentes locuti sunt regi super edicto: Rex,
And they approached and spoke to the king about the edict.
numquid non constituisti ut omnis homo qui rogaret quemquam de diis et hominibus usque ad dies triginta,
“O king, did you not decree that every man who makes a request to any of the gods or men for thirty days, except to yourself,
would be cast into the den of lions?”
To which the king replied, saying,
Verus est sermo juxta decretum Medorum atque Persarum,
“The sentence is true, and according to the decree of the Medes and Persians,
it is not lawful to violate it.”
Then they answered and said before the king,
“Daniel, of the sons of the captivity of Judah,
is not concerned about your law,
et de edicto quod constituisti: sed tribus temporibus per diem orat obsecratione sua.
nor about the decree that you have established, but three times a day he prays his supplication.”
Now when the king had heard these words,
et pro Daniele posuit cor ut liberaret eum,
on behalf of Daniel, he set his heart to free him,
et usque ad occasum solis laborabat ut erueret illum.
and he labored even until sunset to rescue him.

cibique non sunt allati coram eo,
and food was not set before him,
Then the king, getting himself up at first light,

he cried out with a tearful voice to Daniel and spoke to him.

quia coram eo justitia inventa est in me:

Tunc vehementer rex gavisus est super eo,
Then was the king exceedingly glad for him,
et Danielem præcepit educi de lacu:
and he commanded that Daniel should be taken out of the den.
And Daniel was taken out of the den,
et nulla læsio inventa est in eo,
and no wound was found in him,
because he believed in his God.
Moreover, by order of the king,
adducti sunt viri illi, qui accusaverant Danielem:
those men were brought who had accused Daniel,
et in lacum leonum missi sunt,
and they were cast into the lions’ den,

et non pervenerunt usque ad pavimentum laci, donec arriperent eos leones, et omnia ossa eorum comminuerunt.
and they did not reach the bottom of the den before the lions seized them and crushed all their bones.
Tunc Darius rex scripsit universis populis,
Then king Darius wrote to all peoples,
et linguis habitantibus in universa terra:
and languages dwelling in all the land.
It is hereby established by my decree that,
ut in universo imperio et regno meo, tremiscant et paveant Deum Danielis:

ipse est enim Deus vivens, et æternus in sæcula,

Porro Daniel perseveravit usque ad regnum Darii, regnumque Cyri Persæ.
Thereafter, Daniel continued through the reign of Darius until the reign of Cyrus, the Persian.
